winning_payline_count: A payline wins only when all five symbols on that horizontal row match. How many paylines win?
Count the horizontal paylines where all five visible symbols are the same.
How many of the three horizontal paylines show five matching symbols?
A row is a winning payline if every reel in that row shows the same symbol. How many winning paylines are shown?

code_prompt_defaults.object_description: a toy slot machine with five reels, three visible horizontal paylines, and simple symbol icons

code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract_answer_only: Return JSON with exactly one key: "answer".
